node.statement: The row-geometry clause of def-signed-idempotent gives ||P||_{inf->inf} <= 1+2delta, hence ||P-I||_{inf->inf} <= 2+2delta. For each row, q_iQ-q_i=e_i(P-I)+q_iD because P^2=P; with q_i nonnegative of total mass 1, ||q_iD||_1 <= ||D||_{inf->inf} <= 2delta and ||e_i(P-I)||_1 <= (2delta)(2+2delta), so ||Q^2-Q||_{inf->inf} <= 6delta+4delta^2.
